boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University Park settings for quiet work, group projects, and technology-based coursework.

cards.title: Knowledge Commons One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Paterno Library • University Park
cards.notes: Use the camera, projector, iMac, lighting, and microphone to rehearse or record a class presentation; bring files on a USB drive.
cards.short_summary: A Paterno Library recording space for presentation-based coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries lists a One Button Studio in the Knowledge Commons at University Park and describes its recording equipment.
cards.source_title: One Button Studio | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Contact Media Commons for University Park assistance and confirm availability before recording.

cards.title: Engineering Library One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Engineering Library • University Park
cards.notes: Set up slides on the iMac, then use the room’s camera and projector for a recorded project presentation or practice run.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated recording setup inside the Engineering Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries lists a One Button Studio at the Engineering Library and describes its camera, projector, computer, and microphone.
cards.source_title: One Button Studio | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Contact Media Commons for University Park assistance and confirm availability before recording.

cards.entity_name: Earth and Mineral Sciences Library One Button Studio
cards.title: EMS Library One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Earth and Mineral Sciences Library • University Park
cards.notes: Use the studio’s built-in camera, lighting, microphone, and greenscreen capability when a course assignment needs a polished video component.
cards.short_summary: A media-production study setting within the EMS Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries lists a One Button Studio at the Earth and Mineral Sciences Library and documents its audiovisual equipment.
cards.source_title: One Button Studio | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Contact Media Commons for University Park assistance and confirm availability before recording.

cards.entity_name: Physical and Mathematical Sciences Library One Button Studio
cards.title: Physical & Mathematical Sciences One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Physical and Mathematical Sciences Library • University Park
cards.notes: Prepare a short explainer or presentation here using the studio’s iMac, projector, camera, and one-button recording workflow.
cards.short_summary: A presentation-recording workspace in the physical and mathematical sciences library.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries lists a One Button Studio at the Physical and Mathematical Sciences Library and describes its recording setup.
cards.source_title: One Button Studio | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Contact Media Commons for University Park assistance and confirm availability before recording.

cards.title: EMS Library Virtual Reality Center
cards.subtitle: Earth and Mineral Sciences Library • University Park
cards.notes: Book a session to explore STEM-related virtual-reality apps on the HTC Vive system when a class project benefits from immersive visualization.
cards.short_summary: A bookable VR setting for STEM-focused exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries identifies the EMS Library Virtual Reality Center as open to Penn State students and says HTC Vive sessions can be booked.
cards.source_title: Virtual Reality Resources at Penn State | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The source says sessions can be booked; verify current booking instructions before going.

cards.title: The Dreamery
cards.subtitle: Basement, Shields Building • University Park
cards.notes: Use this co-learning space to explore VR or AR headsets with classmates, faculty, or staff when testing emerging learning technologies.
cards.short_summary: A Shields Building co-learning space for VR and AR exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries describes The Dreamery in the Shields Building basement as a co-learning space with VR and AR headsets.
cards.source_title: Virtual Reality Resources at Penn State | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access and headset availability with the relevant campus unit before visiting.

cards.title: Immersive Experiences Lab
cards.subtitle: 109 Agricultural Sciences and Industries Building • University Park
cards.notes: Plan a 360-degree media assignment here when you need editing computers, 360 cameras, or headsets in a dedicated creation space.
cards.short_summary: A campus lab equipped for 360-degree media creation and viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries says the Immersive Experiences Lab in 109 Agricultural Sciences and Industries has 360° video equipment and headsets.
cards.source_title: Virtual Reality Resources at Penn State | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access, equipment availability, and any required training before using the lab.

cards.title: Knowledge Commons Public Computers
cards.subtitle: Pattee Library Knowledge Commons • University Park
cards.notes: Use a public Windows computer when you need campus-installed EndNote X5 to organize citations, references, images, or PDFs.
cards.short_summary: A public-computer option for citation-management work.
cards.evidence_claim: A Penn State Libraries guide states that EndNote X5 is available on public Windows computers in Pattee Library Knowledge Commons.
cards.source_title: EndNote Overview | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Software availability can change; confirm the current public-computer setup before relying on this location.

cards.title: Sidewater Commons Public Computers
cards.subtitle: Pattee Library • University Park
cards.notes: Choose a public Windows computer here when your research workflow needs the EndNote X5 desktop application and campus library access.
cards.short_summary: A Pattee Library computer area for reference-management tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: A Penn State Libraries guide states that EndNote X5 is available on public Windows computers in Sidewater Commons at University Park.
cards.source_title: EndNote Overview | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Software availability can change; confirm the current public-computer setup before relying on this location.

cards.title: Warnock Commons Study Space
cards.subtitle: Warnock Commons • North Halls, University Park
cards.notes: Set up in the residence-area study space for a nearby work session, then use the building’s shared amenities during an on-campus break.
cards.short_summary: A study area in the 24-hour Warnock Commons Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State LiveOn says Warnock Commons is open 24 hours a day and includes study space for students.
cards.access_notes: Penn State LiveOn states that the Warnock Commons Building is open 24 hours/day; follow building and residence-life access rules.
